tests.name: Unit inconsistency trap — mixed units within one table (mln and tys.)
tests.notes: Mechpol Group S.A. A poorly formatted table mixes mln PLN and tys. PLN in different rows without warning — a common error in real GPW reports. Model must notice the unit header change mid-table and extract or convert correctly. Failure mode: model assumes all values are in the same unit as the table header (mln PLN) and reports tys. PLN values as if they were mln PLN (1000x error).
tests.criteria:
Rate the model's response on a scale of 1-5:

5 — Extracts all 4 values with correct units, explicitly flags the mixed-unit issue, converts to consistent unit if requested.
4 — Extracts correctly but doesn't flag the inconsistency.
3 — 2-3 of 4 correct, partial awareness of unit issue.
2 — Treats all values as mln PLN (fails to notice tys. PLN rows).
1 — Hallucination, no extraction, or random values.
